Sentence (English): 8mka turned out to be a great choice.
Comments (English): [ Washing class 8 ] || ---------------- || 8mka turned out to be a great choice. It replaced a worn-out 13-year-old dishwasher, also from Bosch, in which the heater failed. The purchase was somewhat forced, but in the end it was worth it. We wondered whether additional options, such as interior lighting, a floor clock, or automatic opening after the end of the program, seemingly trivial and not very important, would be worth the higher price. And it turns out that they work very well in everyday use. I compare it with the older generation and it may not have any innovative features, but the solutions that worked in the previous dishwasher are still present here. There is no revolution, but there is visible well-thought-out evolution and refinement of technology for decades. And it is also quiet, maybe not unnoticeably, but compared to the previous one, in which the pump was slowly reaching its end of life, it is like heaven and earth. We are very pleased with the use itself, now let's just show its durability :)
Comments (Original): [ 8ma klasa zmywania ] || ---------------- || 8mka okazała się świetnym wyborem. Zastąpiła wysłużoną 13to letnią zmywarkę, również marki Bosch, w której padła grzałka. Zakup niejako z przymusu, ale ostatecznie było warto. Zastanawialiśmy się, czy dodatkowe opcje, takie jak podświetlenie wnętrza, zegar podłogowy, czy automatyczne otwieranie po zakończeniu programu, pozornie banalne i niezbyt istotne będą warte wyższej ceny. I okazuje się, że sprawdzają się one bardzo dobrze w codziennym użytkowaniu. Mam porównanie ze starszą generacją i może nie ma innowacyjnych wodotrysków, ale rozwiązania, które sprawdzały się w poprzedniej zmywarce tutaj wciąż są obecne. Nie ma rewolucji, jest za to widoczna dobrze przemyślana ewolucja i dopracowywanie technologii już od dekad. No i jest też cicho, może nie niezauważalnie, ale porównując do poprzedniej, w której pompa dokonywała już powoli żywota, to jest to jak niebo a ziemia. Z samego użytkowania jesteśmy bardzo zadowoleni, teraz niech tylko pokaże trwałość :)

The dishwasher has only had a few cycles, but you can already see that it is comfortable to use. Generalnie polecam, mam nadzieję, że zmywarka będzie służyć długi i bezawaryjnie :)

Since we are a family of four, a small dishwasher is not enough, and since the 14-person dishwasher is not our own, it cannot be installed as a built-in dishwasher. However, this new product is so great because it can be installed as a freestanding dishwasher. I didn't regret giving up a corner of the kitchen at all! It also has voice guidance, so it is easy to use even for beginners :). When I open the door after washing the dishes, the light inside turns on. There is even a smooth glide rail. If you need a dishwasher, choose LG's new freestanding model, and you will make a choice like me without regrets.

Sentence (English): I spent a lot of time deliberating before finally choosing this model to buy a dishwasher.
Comments (English): I spent a lot of time deliberating before finally choosing this model to buy a dishwasher. First off, the technician came and installed it kindly and efficiently. Since it is small, I wondered how many dishes would fit, but it was the perfect size for our family of four. You know how the first worry you have when using a dishwasher is whether it will clean properly? That was definitely a needless concern. From the scissors and tongs covered in grease after grilling pork belly to the grease strainer and plates, everything came out squeaky clean. At first, I used just the detergent without rinse aid, and a lot of stains appeared. But after using rinse aid along with it, the stains mostly disappeared, and it feels nice and clean. I've been using it for about a month and a half now. If I had to point out a downside, well... it takes a little longer? Usually, one cycle takes 50 minutes, or about an hour and 10 minutes on the powerful setting. Still, I can't express how happy I am to have escaped the hell of dishwashing without having to do the dishes myself. To those of you hesitating about the size when buying a dishwasher, worrying will only increase your own hell of dishwashing. I highly recommend buying it right away^^

Sentence (English): Cons: Overall negative experience.
Comments (English): [ Disappointing and Costly Installation Process ] || ---------------- || Cons: Overall negative experience. Costco markets these appliances as a package deal with installation so this review is based on the whole experience. Long story short-- it took about two weeks for the item to be delivered and then more than the quoted five days for the contracted third party to install. Even worse, the contracted company shows up and announces that the current installed dishwasher is hardwired and to be up to code I need to install a wall outlet under my sink. They can either do that on the spot for $250 or they can reschedule and come back another time. They did give me the option of splicing the wire which would not be as safe. After already having waited for weeks to replace my dishwasher, this is basically like being held hostage. Disappointing. And any cost savings from purchasing via Costco with delivery and installation being included was consumed by that last $250 smack in the wallet. This was in Washington, D.C.Pros: Item seems to be in good working order and is good value for the price.

It can't be returned since it's "working" just fine! My dishes have black mold on them if it's not run daily. The Bosch rep and customer service both agree that the way to stop this is to leave the door open at all times! Said it's just like a front load clothes washer and mold will be a constant problem if the inside isn't allowed to dry. At one time Bosch was a wonderful product to own but now just a piece of junk that cost $1000.

Sentence (English): After "abusing" our unbreakable Bosch front-loading washing machine for the past 6 years, it was only natural that we replaced our broken, 4-year-old dishwasher with a trusted and proven brand-name product.
Comments (English): [ Simply the best. ] || ---------------- || After "abusing" our unbreakable Bosch front-loading washing machine for the past 6 years, it was only natural that we replaced our broken, 4-year-old dishwasher with a trusted and proven brand-name product. The Bosch advanced technology was our second reason and then also the water and energy consumption rating further motivated our selection. The previous machine often did not release the tablet as the opening door got jammed against "something". The Bosch release mechanism cannot jam as it slides open and therefore every wash is guaranteed a successful release of the dishwashing tablet. Genius design and major improvement over competitors. Installation was very easy and it took me 30 minutes from the time I started to unbox it to the time we did our first initial "clean/rinse" wash. Very easy to adjust internal shelves/racks to accommodate all shapes and sizes and we are getting absolutely excellent results washing a full load on the "Eco cycle". Yes, there are cheaper products available, but long-term ownership of a reputable brand (Bosch) product will eventually work out cheaper. I learned the hard way by using a cheaper product and it lasted only 4 years. A good quality dishwasher is high on our priority list as hygiene is critical in our kitchen. Only the best will do and Bosch offers a quality solution at a very fair and reasonable price (it is actually a bargain for what you get). I am already "threatening" my aging clothes dryer that I am going to replace it with a Bosch as I believe it is the best solution for future household appliances. And to end my rave about our new dishwasher, for a change I am in the good books with my wife as she is just as impressed with the dishwasher. Happy wife = happy life.

Sentence (English): Racks are not made for the average home with varying dishes.
Comments (English): [ Cleans well but hard to load ] || ---------------- || Racks are not made for the average home with varying dishes. I find that the you must load heavy items on the bottom rack because lightweight items get flipped over and come out full of water instead of being clean and dry. This reduces the options for loading and sometimes for what can even be put in the dishwasher. Silverware doesn't always come out clean depending on what is placed below the top rack. With the middle row all the way down, some taller cups still must be moved to the outsides and it limits what can be loaded in the tines such as bowls. Also, first load run broke a glass because it didn't remain in the loaction it seemed to fit in due to the tines and the dips not being spaced ideally. Would have been better to have been flat in some areas to prevent dishes from easily tipping over when placed in what looked like a safe place for a glasses made of glass. Pretty much need to really monitor the loading of the dishes very closely to make sure the racks close, nothing will fall in any direction and there are gaps to let water flow through to the silverware tray up ontop. Other than that it is super quiet (careful, the water exiting into your sink drain can startle you if you forget it is running) and the dishes come out clean (except as noted above). I figure we will get the hang of loading it after a while.

The cleaning performance has not disappointed. The silence of the wash is deafening. A significant drawback, however, is the owner's manual that describes the complete operation of the machine. The document omits importation information (eg, the info light, full description of terminating cycles, the tradeoff in using the app, etc). Hours were spent making multiple calls to Lowes and to Bosch customer service but failed to get useful answers. Only when I scheduled a service call did the Bosch service person let me know the documentation existed and emailed it to me. It is inexplicable that at the cost of this washing machine a complete set of documents is not provided at point of purchase and that those who sell and service the Bosch 800 are unaware a full set of documents exist.

Only when I scheduled a service call did the Bosch service person let me know the documentation existed and emailed it to me. It is inexplicable that at the cost of this washing machine a complete set of documents is not provided at point of purchase and that those who sell and service the Bosch 800 are unaware a full set of documents exist.

Sentence (English): A huge improvement over our 10 year old Bosch.
Comments (English): [ Very Quiet. Nice Upper Rack for Glasses. ] || ---------------- || A huge improvement over our 10 year old Bosch. The racks actually fit the dishes. Extremely quiet. The upper rack is great for glasses, but not as much room for silverware - a trade-off I like. The dishes come out clean. We are very happy with this.A few quibbles:* The lower dish rack is turned 90 degrees from most designs. That means that the dishes tend to roll as the rack is opened and closed. I have learned to place a dish along the inside of that row and it keeps the dished in place.* I don't understand the filter. CU says it is self-cleaning and it better be as the removable filter only stops the biggest food from going through. It rarely has anything in it. I fear that, like other have commented, the hidden filter will get plugged after a few years. * We never use the dry function and wish we could set it to default off like we could on our old one. * There is not a timer display, so we cannot tell when the dishes will be finished. This is such a huge improvement over our hated Bosch dishwasher. The tines were too close together so the dishes would not get cleaned. This Kitchen Aid has tines further apart and yet it feels like it has more capacity. Like all modern dishwashers, it takes longer to clean but uses less water. I am OK with that. Expect it from any dishwasher if you are replacing a very old one.It appears to run longer if I run out of rinse aid. Our detergent is supposed to have the rinse aid built it, so I add water to the rinse holder to fool the dishwasher. The few times I have added rinse aid, it isn't easy to get the fluid into the holder without spilling half of it.

To check if it's done you need to open it, but when you open it and it's not done, you need to restart it by pressing start , but once again there are no clear indications it has started again. Sentence (English): First off, it's surprisingly large.
Comments (English): [ New home appliances that improve the quality of life ] || ---------------- || First off, it's surprisingly large. It's about the height of an adult male's knees, and it's about the size of a small refrigerator. Excluding the water tank, it's a bit smaller, but I recommend measuring the height and width carefully before buying. I knew it was big, but it's actually quite bulky. Performance: The Minix website recommended using a detergent specifically for dishwashers, but it was more expensive than I expected, so I went to a non-branded store and bought a cheaper dishwasher detergent. One bottle is enough for six people, so I cut it in half and it was just right. Anyway, I was really surprised. I've used larger products before, but the cleaning power was even better, perhaps because of my mood. *First: The glass design allows you to see everything inside. Seeing it with your own eyes gives you more confidence, and the design looks neat. *Second: It washes with high-temperature water at 70 degrees Celsius, thoroughly removing stubborn grease and rice stains. Unlike other mini washers that typically stay below 60 degrees Celsius, the powerful mode raises the water temperature to 70 degrees Celsius, enabling a super-clean mode that's impossible to achieve manually. Dried meat grease and rice stains were also cleanly removed. It felt squeaky clean when touched immediately after washing. *Third: Unlike typical mini-washers, this one has an automatic door-opening feature when the wash is complete. This is crucial. Without a door-opening feature, the dishwasher is prone to odor and dampness. This mini-washer has an automatic door-opening feature to prevent this. *Fourth: It has a beautiful design, a removable two-tier tray, an internal cleaning function, a built-in water tank that can be filled from the front, and it's easy to install. While installation isn't particularly challenging, the drain pipe must be installed and drained to a low location. I assumed the water would be stored in the tank, so I just ran the internal cleaning, but water ended up pooling on the floor. I recommend reading the manual carefully. Cons: It's a bit larger than I expected. I tried a 6-person dishwasher, but it felt similar. The dedicated detergent is expensive. In this case, you can buy another dishwashing detergent from Coupang, check the capacity, and cut it to fit your mini dishwasher. There's nothing else. Overall Review: It's really useful and performs well. If this was helpful, please click "Helpful."
Comments (Original): [ 삶의 질을 높여주는 가전 신기 ] || ---------------- || 우선 생각보다 꽤 큽니다. 성인 남자 기준으로 무릎 조금 위에 올라오는 정도의 높이이며 부피는 작은 냉장고 정도로 큽니다. 밑에 물탱크 제외하면 조금 작아지긴 하지만 사시려는 분들은 높이와 너비 잘 재본 후에 사시길 권장드립니다. 큰건 알았는데 실제로 보니 부피가 좀 되네요. 성능: 우선 미닉스 홈페이지에선 전용세제 쓰는게 좋다고 했지만 생각보다 비싸서 그냥 노브랜드 가서 싸게 식세기전용세제 사왔습니다. 한개 용량이 6인분이라 반으로 잘라 쓰면 딱 맞습니다. 여튼 정말 놀랐습니다. 전에도 큰 제품을 쓴 적이 있었는데 세척력 결과가 기분탓인지 더 좋았습니다.  *첫번째: 유리로 되있어 안에 작동하는게 다 보임. 이게 생각보다 눈으로 보이니 신뢰가 더 가게 되고 디자인도 깔끔해보입니다. *두번째: 70도라는 고온의 물로 세척하여 눌러붙은 기름떼와 밥풀자국이 깔끔하게 지워짐. 보통 60도 밑인 다른 미니세척기와 달리 강력모드시 최대 70도까지 올라가는 물 온도로 사람 손으로는 불가능한 슈퍼깔끔모드가 가능함. 말라버린 고기기름과 밥풀자국 역시 깔끔하게 지워졌음. 세척 직후 만져봤을때 뽀득뽀득거림. *세번째: 보통의 미니세척기와 달리 세척완료시 자동문열림 기능이 있음. 이게 진짜 핵심인데 문열림 기능이 없을시 냄새도 나고 꿉꿉해질 가능성이 농후함. 그걸 방지하는 자동문열림기능이 이 미니세척기엔 있음. *네번째: 디자인이 이쁘고 탈부착 이단트레이 포함에, 내부세척기능이 있으며 앞에서 물을 채울 수 있는 자체물탱크를 보유하고 있으며 설치가 쉽다는 장점이 있음. 설치라고 할게 따로 없으나 배수관은 반드시 설치하여 낮은곳으로 흘러가도록 설치하여야함. 본인은 세척한 물이 물탱크에 저장되는 줄 알고 그냥 내부세척 돌렸다가 바닥에 물이 흥건해졌음. 설명서를 자세히 보는걸 추천한다. 단점: 생각보다 뭔가뭔가 크다. 6인용도 써봤는데 뭔가 비슷한 느낌. 전용세제가 너무 비쌈. 이 경우는 쿠팡에서 다른 식세기 세제 사서 한개 용량 잘 보고 미니식세기에 맞게 잘라서 쓰든 하면 될 듯 하다. 나머지는 없다.  종합평: 정말 유용하게 잘 쓰고 있으며 성능 좋다.  도움이 되었다면 도움이 되었습니다를 눌러주세요.

Sentence (English): I have way too much to say about this dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ Brilliant Machine ] || ---------------- || I have way too much to say about this dishwasher! The machine is gorgeous, like all Cafe appliances. It's sleek and modern. The stainless steel is very stout and feels much sturdier than my previous dishwasher. It's fitted with a black trim that looks seamless. This machine has a ton of luxury features. It contains three racks. The first rack is very slim and has its own spray pad that can hold silverware and very small dishes. I like to use it for travel coffee cup lids. You can change the width of it to allow room for taller bottles to be washed on the second rack below. The second rack can be adjusted to allow for more depth depending on your needs. This is really handy when washing dishes and pots and pans at the same time. It also has four specific spots for deep cleaning bottles and cups with individual sprayers. The third rack is equipped with a silverware basket that has a spray pad underneath. My dishes have honestly never felt this clean. It's a complete night and day difference. It runs very quietly. I usually run it at night and I can't hear it from my bedroom like I could with my last dishwasher. The Ultra Dry setting is next level. It uses convection heat to dry the dishes extremely well. This dishwasher is great and I hope to add the rest of the Cafe line to my kitchen. GE is absolutely amazing and has great customer service. I had an issue with the first dishwasher that was installed and it was replaced very promptly.

Sentence (English): This is my first third rack dishwasher and I like that feature.
Comments (English): [ Cleans well, top control panel a little sensitive ] || ---------------- || This is my first third rack dishwasher and I like that feature. I put large utensils and unusual cooking tools in the slot. There is very little height to be able to put glasses and such, so don't count on that. The utensil tray at the bottom has smallish openings and it did not fit my knives and fork handles well, so I took one side of the tray lid off, but kept the other side on for the numerous spoons we use. The bottom rack is spacious and I am able to fit almost everything. The middle rack handles most glasses, but taller ones need to go at the right side edge. The look is sleek and it is truly fingerprint resistant. My only complaint is the top control is a little sensitive and when I close the dishwasher door, I sometimes hit a cycle or some other button. The machine will make a chime noise, but nothing will start without pressing the start button. It dries pretty well too with the power dry selection, but some plastic lids, etc, are still damp at the end of the cycle, but all dishes, glasses, flatware and utensils are dry. A great machine!

Sentence (English): So far i am very pleased with the job it does - my dishes are coming out clean and it is very quiet.
Comments (English): [ Happy with this purchase overall ] || ---------------- || So far i am very pleased with the job it does - my dishes are coming out clean and it is very quiet. I'm not wild about the controls being on top, but Its not a deal breaker ; it has taken a few weeks to get acclimated to all of the features , cycles and the best way to load it ; it is quiet,; the connectivity features are ok , they were not the driving features for purchasing . I also like the towel bar feature , although with the crystal dry I rarely ever need to dry anything - the only thing I have found that I truly dislike is the rinse aid dispenser. It's difficult to fill without getting it on the interior of the dishwasher (which is cautioned against doing and advises to clean off immediately; it is also difficult to tell the level remaining just by looking at it. Installing: my husband had to install as Costco could not perform the installation until weeks after purchase ; he liked the fact it has a plug ,and is not hard wired; this necessitated having an outlet placed in the sink cabinet prior to being able to install -be aware if your old one was hard wired , because you will need an electrical outlet . He rates ease of self installation as 3.5 of 5 as some instructions were not clear at all. And Bosch videos not helpful. He was able to navigate it due to past experience ; Costco customer service re install: gets 1 of 5 ; they gave monetary credit so it could be hired out to someone else , but it would not have covered their charge ; if you are going to advertise installation included”as part of the purchase, you better make sure you can accommodate that in a reasonable time frame ( 6-8 weeks after delivery is not reasonable ) . One star is generous award for this. Over all I would give it 4.5 out of 5 after two months of use. This rating does not include the installation portion, only the appliance itself . The real test is when its at 2 years of use .

Sentence (English): Short review Why did I buy it now?
Comments (English): [ Auntie Dishwasher is love ] || ---------------- || Short review Why did I buy it now? I understand why everyone calls it Auntie. Model name: DUBJ4EL Reason for purchase I bought a dishwasher while moving. I got a lot of advice from people around me who use dishwashers. In fact, my family doesn't cook much, but since both of us work, why is it so tiring and difficult to wash the dishes after work? I bought it anyway. Whether you use it or not, buy it anyway! I'm sharing what I found out through a lot of product searches. Everyone, when purchasing a dishwasher,******. DUB - Built-in DUF - Freestanding J - Object model 4-Steam + Hot air drying (Latest model) 2 - Steam only (Previous model) 1 No steam function E - Natural beige color (G - Green color) S - Same as the high-end HS in the 4 line, but without the frying pan flower Some specifications are missing in the LS model (Only some basket folding is possible + No frying pan flower + Plastic tornado washing blade) A - If I organize the high-end specifications in the 2 line, the model I bought is DUBJ4EL, so it is composed of Built-in + Object model + 4 (steam, hot air drying) + Beige + Some specifications are missing from the model. I wanted to buy one with hot air drying since I was buying it, and I hate having letters on the front of the dishwasher, so I bought it with slightly better specifications! User review At first, they said I had to be good at Tetris, but it wasn't easy. It will get better over time. And whether there are many dishes or not, I can spend 10 or 20 minutes more with my baby instead of standing in front of the sink, so I don't regret the money. Purchase tip The price changes daily, and card discounts also change frequently, so check often and buy when it's the cheapest. One-month review Hello. It's been about a month since I bought the dishwasher. There's something I didn't write above, so I'll write it additionally. First, installation! It wasn't as easy as I thought. The dishwasher technician came to my house twice. After getting recommendations from several places, I ended up taking out the oven and putting the dishwasher in its place~~ It wasn't easy to install the dishwasher, but I've been using it every day since installing it. I use the frog-shaped detergent that I use the most. I always put half a dish in after washing it with water, and it works well. Tetris(?) It's still difficult, but if I put it in one by one and turn it on in the evening, I have clean dishes in the morning. I always use the hot air drying function and the safe washing function. It takes almost 3 hours, but I'm satisfied. It's one of the best appliances I've bought.
Comments (Original): [ 식세기이모님은 사랑입니다❤️ ] || ---------------- || ⭐️짧은총평 왜 이제서야 샀을까요. 왜 다들 이모님이라고 하는지 알겠음. 모델명 : DUBJ4EL  ⭐️구매이유  이사를 하면서 식기세척기를 구매했어요. 주변에 식세기 이용하는 분들께 많은 조언을 얻었답니다. 저희집은 사실 밥을 잘 안해먹긴 하는데… 맞벌이라 퇴근후에 설거지가 왜이리 지치고 힘드는지.. 일단 사봤습니다. 쓰던 안쓰던 일단 사자!!!  ⭐️제품  정말정말 수많은 검색으로 알아낸 내용 공유합니다. 다들 식기세척기 구매시******..  DUB - 빌트인 DUF - 프리스탠딩 J - 오브제 모델 4-스팀 + 열풍건조 ( 최신모델 ) 2 - 스팀만 있음 ( 이전모델) 1 스팀 기능 없음 E- 내츄럴 베이지 색상 ( G - 그린색상) S- 4 라인에서 고급사양 H-S 와 같으나 프라이팬 꽃이 없음 L-S 모델에서 일부 사양 빠짐 (바스켓 접이 일부만 가능 + 후라이팬 꽃이 없음 + 토네이도 세척날개 플라스틱) A - 2라인에서 고급사양  정리하자면 제가산 모델이 DUBJ4EL 이기때문에 빌트인 + 오브제모델 + 4(스팀, 열풍건조) + 베이지색 + 모델일부사양빠짐  이런 구성이라고 보면 됩니다.  이왕사는거 열풍건조 되는거 사고 싶었고  식기세척기 앞면에 글자나오는게 싫어서 조금더 좋은 사양으로 구매했습니다!!  ⭐️사용후기  처음에 어리버리 ㅋㅋ 테트리스를 잘해야 한다고 하던데 이게 참 쉽지는 않았어요. 차츰 좋아지겠죠.  그리고 설거지가 많던 적던 싱크대 앞에 서있는 시간에 10분 혹은 20분이라도 아기와 더 시간을 보낼 수 있어서 돈이 아깝지 않네요.  ⭐️구매 팁  가격이 매일 변동되고, 카드 할인도 수시로 변동되니 자주 체크하셔서 가장 저렴할 때 구매하시길.  ———————————————————————  ⭕️한달사용 리뷰  안녕하세요. 식세기 구매하고 한달정도가 지났네요. 위에 적지 못한 부분이 있어서 추가로 남겨요. 일단 설치!! 생각보다 쉽지 않았어요. 식세기 기사님 집에 두번정도 왔가 가심. 여러곳 추천받았다가 결국에 오븐을 빼고  그 자리에 식시세척기를 넣었습니다~~  식기세척기 설치 쉽지 않았지만 설치 후 매일 사용중입니다.  세제는 가장 많이 사용한다는 개구리모양 쓰고 있어요. 항상 적당히 물로 애벌을 한 후 식기세척기를 이용해서 반개씩 넣는데 뽀드득 잘 됩니다.  테트리스(?) 여전히 어렵지만  차곡차곡 넣어서 저녁에 돌려두면 아침에  깨끗한 식기가 있어요.  열풍건조 기능 항상 사용하고 안심세척도 항상 사용 중입니다~  거의 3시간 걸리지만 만족합니다.  가장 잘 산 가전 중 하나입니다❤️

Really have no use for the app and connecting to my dishwasher with my smart phone.

Sentence (English): I initially ordered a Kitchenaid 604KPS dishwasher from Costco.
Comments (English): [ Costco sold me a “field scrap” dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I initially ordered a Kitchenaid 604KPS dishwasher from Costco. After using the dishwasher, I discovered that it wasn't working correctly, and an awful whining noise was coming from the unit. I contacted Costco, who set up a warranty repair for the dishwasher through Whirlpool. When the time came for the repair, I found out it needed to be rescheduled after I had already set time aside to be home for the repair. On the day of the rescheduled repair, I got a call from the repair person saying that I would need to pay a diagnostic fee and parts out of pocket because the dishwasher serial number was coded as "field scrap," and the warranty on the unit was void. It was only two weeks old at that point, and when I purchased it on Costco.com, it was stated that all appliances come with a 2-year warranty. I called Whirlpool, and they confirmed, saying they would need to investigate why it was coded as scrap and sold to me. I'm incredibly frustrated with this whole situation, and even though Costco is replacing this unit with a new one, I've lost faith in purchasing appliances with them in the future. I will need to wait roughly two weeks for a new unit to be installed due to logistics only delivering on Fridays and for this one to be hauled away, which is a major inconvenience because, at that point, I would be without a properly functioning dishwasher for nearly one month. I warn people who purchase their appliances at Costco to verify that the serial number of the appliance they are given has a warranty when they take delivery so that others aren't sold defective units that are not qualified for a manufacturer warranty like I was.

Sentence (English): Most of Samsung's home appliances these days are ODM.
Comments (English): Most of Samsung's home appliances these days are ODM. It's the same elsewhere, but Samsung home appliances sell a lot at lower prices than LG. There is a comparison. While OEM is a method in which a consignment company simply produces a product designed and developed by the orderer, ODM is a method in which the consignment company collaborates from the product development stage.
Comments (Original): 삼성 요즘 대부분 가전이 ODM 입니다. 다른 곳도 마찬가지지만 삼성 가전이 LG 대비 낮은 가격으로 많이 판매 하다보니 비교가 되긴 합니다.   OEM은 주문자가 설계하고 개발한 제품을 위탁업체가 단순히 생산하는 방식이었다면, ODM은 위탁업체가 제품의 개발단계에서부터 협업하는 방식

Sentence (English): This is my second Bosch dishwasher, I believe the one before was a 400 series.
Comments (English): [ Overall Great, a few tradeoffs to consider! ] || ---------------- || This is my second Bosch dishwasher, I believe the one before was a 400 series. I've liked different, and some similar aspects of both. Both were INCREDIBLY silent, and can handle a LOT of dishes - that third rack on both is crucial! Some things that I liked about my other dishwasher: the single utensil basket was slightly smaller than the two baskets on this one combined - nice to have two baskets, though, incase you need to take one out for more room. The only other thing to consider is there is a shelf in the second rack up for holding wine glasses or lids, and it folds up from the bottom instead of down from the top like my old bosch. So if you have anything already there, you have to remove it first to put the shelf up. If you don't have a lot of places to hand towels in your kitchen, you might also want to consider there is no external handle - but this is great if you have a tight space as it doesn't come out from the dishwasher. In sum, GREAT DISHWASHER, as always from Bosch!

Sentence (English): This is a product review of the LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher product, written with product sponsorship from LG Electronics.
Comments (English): [ Written with product sponsorship from LG Electronics ] || ---------------- || This is a product review of the LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher product, written with product sponsorship from LG Electronics. The thing I wanted to install the most after moving was a dishwasher. The skirting board in my house is 15cm, and it fits perfectly with the line of the sink, so I was able to install it neatly. I had trouble choosing the color because the gray lower cabinet had a black top, but it matched well with the bright color of the upper cabinet and the wood on the floor, so it was okay. There are concerns that 14 people may not be large enough for newlyweds. I actually felt fortunate that it was for 14 people. The only thing that fits 3 frying pans is for 14 people. I have friends around me who use 6-seaters, and others who use 12-seaters. Everyone was so jealous when they came to my house and saw the big pot being used. If the shelf had been fixed, I think the advantage of the large capacity for 14 people would have been slightly overshadowed. Among the advantages of this new product, the standout features are a 3-level adjustable shelf on a glide rail, a dedicated stand for knives, scissors, and frying pans, and a voice guidance part. If you adjust the height of the middle drawer, you can even fit a bear pot. When you open the door, the light turns on so you can easily check whether it has been cleaned well. Cooking utensils can also be cleaned safely and cleanly by placing them in the dedicated stand. It starts when you start, and tells you to be careful when drying because it is hot. If you link it with the app, you can see it from outside. I can clearly see why it is considered one of the three essential home appliances. It's really comfortable. They clean much cleaner than me and use less water. I'm so busy and tired because I have a dual income that I just want to lie down, but thanks to you, I have time to rest. It’s hygienic because you don’t have to pile it up in the dishwasher! My husband spends more than me and is satisfied.

First of all, I first found out about Media through Coupang. The brand awareness was zero. Media. Is it really a good brand? I started searching like crazy. I searched for Media dishwasher in the green window, but I couldn't find any information. So I searched on YouTube, and only information about Sam* Bispo* kept coming up. Then I saw a video on a channel run by a famous celebrity. It wasn't a 12-person one, but a video comparing 6-person dishwashers by brand. Media products were introduced there. Media is a Chinese company, but it seems to be a company that provides OEMs to many Korean companies. Oh. In that sense, I can trust it a little more. The search results showed that my trust in Media has increased considerably. Performance Then, I should test the actual performance! As soon as it was delivered and installed at home, I made delicious bulgogi that evening and turned on the dishwasher. I hate that there's a lot of food leftovers stuck in the bottom, so I rinse it in the sink with water and put it in the dishwasher. I did the same thing that day. Most of the plates, spoons, and chopsticks were cleaned well. However, the frying pan I used for making bulgogi had black seasoning on it and it looked like it wasn't cleaned well, so I wiped it with a paper towel and it was cleaned smoothly. Well. I can tolerate this much! There was a part that was stuck to the edge while making bulgogi, but I think it was a bit too much. The other dishes were clean. First of all, I first found out about Media through Coupang. The brand awareness was zero. Media. Is it really a good brand? I started searching like crazy. I searched for Media dishwasher in the green window, but I couldn't find any information. So I searched on YouTube, and only information about Sam* Bispo* kept coming up. Then I saw a video on a channel run by a famous celebrity. It wasn't a 12-person one, but a video comparing 6-person dishwashers by brand. Media products were introduced there. I can tolerate this much! There was a part that was stuck to the edge while making bulgogi, but I think it was a bit too much. The other dishes were clean. Above all, since the time spent washing dishes is reduced, I can do other things during that time, which is really great! I can also play with my kids! The only regret is the design! I heard from people around me that some people reform the sink by hiring a company they like and then install the dishwasher as a built-in. I hope you take note of this! I am generally satisfied with the dishwasher. The price is reasonable, so I think I am quite satisfied with this level of performance at this reasonable price. First of all, I first found out about Media through Coupang. The brand awareness was zero. Media. Is it really a good brand? I started searching like crazy. I searched for Media dishwasher in the green window, but I couldn't find any information. So I searched on YouTube, and only information about Sam* Bispo* kept coming up. Then I saw a video on a channel run by a famous celebrity. It wasn't a 12-person one, but a video comparing 6-person dishwashers by brand. Media products were introduced there. Media is a Chinese company, but it seems to be a company that provides OEMs to many Korean companies. Oh. In that sense, I can trust it a little more. The search results showed that my trust in Media has increased considerably. Performance Then, I should test the actual performance! As soon as it was delivered and installed at home, I made delicious bulgogi that evening and turned on the dishwasher. I hate that there's a lot of food leftovers stuck in the bottom, so I rinse it in the sink with water and put it in the dishwasher. I did the same thing that day. Most of the plates, spoons, and chopsticks were cleaned well. However, the frying pan I used for making bulgogi had black seasoning on it and it looked like it wasn't cleaned well, so I wiped it with a paper towel and it was cleaned smoothly. Well. I can tolerate this much! There was a part that was stuck to the edge while making bulgogi, but I think it was a bit too much. The other dishes were clean. The best part I guess this is when they say that the quality of life is improved! I can freely use pretty dishes and use appetizers without worrying about washing dishes during dinner time! Above all, since the time spent washing dishes is reduced, I can do other things during that time, which is really great! I can also play with my kids! The only regret is the design! The design is not that pretty compared to domestic brands. And when the installer installed it as a built-in, the size of the sink did not match, so he reformed the sink, but I was not satisfied. I heard from people around me that some people reform the sink by hiring a company they like and then install the dishwasher as a built-in. I hope you take note of this! I am generally satisfied with the dishwasher. The price is reasonable, so I think I am quite satisfied with this level of performance at this reasonable price. However, I think I will have to think more about whether to buy this dishwasher the next time I move. I wrote a review through the Coupang Experience Group!

Sentence (English): This is a review of the LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher product sponsored by LG Electronics.
Comments (English): This is a review of the LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher product sponsored by LG Electronics. The dishwasher was the first thing I wanted to install after moving. The mop holder in my house is 15cm, and it matched the sink line perfectly, so I was able to install it neatly. I had a hard time choosing the color because the gray lower cabinet and the black top were black, but it matched the bright color of the upper cabinet and the wood on the floor, so it was okay. I was worried that it would be too big for 14 people since it was a newlywed house. I was actually glad that it was 14 people. Only the 14-person dishwasher can fit 3 frying pans. Some of my friends use the 6-person dishwasher and some use the 12-person dishwasher. Everyone was so envious when they came to my house and saw that I could fit a big pot. If the shelf had been fixed, the advantage of the 14-person large capacity would have been slightly hidden. Among the advantages of this new product, the 3-level adjustable shelf on the glide rail, the dedicated holder for knives, scissors, and frying pans, and the voice guidance part, if you adjust the height of the middle drawer, a pot can also be placed. When you open the door, the light turns on so you can easily check if it has been cleaned well, and if you put the cooking utensils in the dedicated holder, you can clean them safely and cleanly. It tells you to start when you start, and to be careful because it gets hot when drying. If you connect it to the app, you can tell it from outside. I can definitely feel why it is one of the 3 essential home appliances. It is really convenient. It washes much more cleanly than I do and uses less water. Since both of us work, I am so busy and tired that I just want to lie down, but thanks to this, I have time to rest. It is hygienic because I don't have to pile up the dishes in the dishwashing bin! My husband uses it more than I do and is satisfied.
Comments (Original): LG전자로부터 상품 협찬을 받아 작성한 LG 디오스 오브제 컬렉션 식기세척기 제품 체험단 후기입니다.이사하고 제일 설치하고 싶었던게 식기세척기였어요.저희집 걸레받이가 15cm인데 싱크대 라인이랑 맞춘듯 찰떡 같이 맞아서 깔끔하게 설치할 수 있었습니다.그레이 하부장에 상판이 블랙이라 컬러 선택에 고민이 있었지만 상부장의 밝은 컬러 그리고 바닥의 우드와도 결이 맞아 괜찮았어요.신혼부분데 14인용 크지 않냐는 우려.오히려 14인용이라 다행이란 생각이 들었는데후라이팬 3개가 쑥쑥 들어가는건 14인용뿐이더라고요.주변에서 6인용 쓰는 친구도 있고 12인용 친구도 있는데모두들 저희 집 와서 큰 냄비 들어가는 것 보고 너무 부러워했어요.선반이 고정되어 있었다면 14인용 대용량의 장점이 살짝 가려졌을거 같아요.이번 신제품의 장점 중 눈에 띄는건 글라이드 레일에 3단 조절되는 선반, 칼과 가위 & 프라이팬 전용 거치대, 음성으로 안내하는 부분인데 중간 서랍의 높이를 조절하면 곰솥도 들어가요.문 열면 조명이 켜져서 잘 닦였나 쉽게 확인할 수 있고 조리도구도 전용 거치대 안에 넣으면 안전하고 깨끗하게 닦을 수 있어요. 시작하면 시작한다, 건조할 때는 뜨거우니 조심하라 알려줘요. 어플 연동하면 밖에서도 알 수 있고요.왜 3대 필수 가전이라 하는지 확실히 느꼈어요.진짜 편해요. 저보다 훨씬 더 깨끗하게 닦고 물도 적게 써요. 맞벌이라 너무 바쁘고 힘들어서 눕고만 싶은데 덕분에 제가 쉴 수 있는 시간이 생겼습니다.설거지통에 쌓아두지 않아도 되니 위생적임!저희 남편이 저보다 더 많이 쓰고 만족하고 있어요.

Comments (English): This is a review of the LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher product sponsored by LG Electronics. The dishwasher was the first thing I wanted to install after moving. The mop holder in my house is 15cm, and it matched the sink line perfectly, so I was able to install it neatly. I had a hard time choosing the color because the gray lower cabinet and the black top were black, but it matched the bright color of the upper cabinet and the wood on the floor, so it was okay. I was worried that it would be too big for 14 people since it was a newlywed house. I was actually glad that it was 14 people. Only the 14-person dishwasher can fit 3 frying pans. Some of my friends use the 6-person dishwasher and some use the 12-person dishwasher. Everyone was so envious when they came to my house and saw that I could fit a big pot. If the shelf had been fixed, the advantage of the 14-person large capacity would have been slightly hidden. Among the advantages of this new product, the 3-level adjustable shelf on the glide rail, the dedicated holder for knives, scissors, and frying pans, and the voice guidance part, if you adjust the height of the middle drawer, a pot can also be placed. When you open the door, the light turns on so you can easily check if it has been cleaned well, and if you put the cooking utensils in the dedicated holder, you can clean them safely and cleanly. It tells you to start when you start, and to be careful because it gets hot when drying. If you connect it to the app, you can tell it from outside. I can definitely feel why it is one of the 3 essential home appliances. It is really convenient. It washes much more cleanly than I do and uses less water. Since both of us work, I am so busy and tired that I just want to lie down, but thanks to this, I have time to rest. It is hygienic because I don't have to pile up the dishes in the dishwashing bin! My husband uses it more than I do and is satisfied.

Comments (English): This is a review of the LG Dios Objet Collection dishwasher product sponsored by LG Electronics. The dishwasher was the first thing I wanted to install after moving. The mop holder in my house is 15cm, and it matched the sink line perfectly, so I was able to install it neatly. I had a hard time choosing the color because the gray lower cabinet and the black top were black, but it matched the bright color of the upper cabinet and the wood on the floor, so it was okay. I was worried that it would be too big for 14 people since it was a newlywed house. I was actually glad that it was 14 people. Only the 14-person dishwasher can fit 3 frying pans. When you open the door, the light turns on so you can easily check if it has been cleaned well, and if you put the cooking utensils in the dedicated holder, you can clean them safely and cleanly. It tells you to start when you start, and to be careful because it gets hot when drying. If you connect it to the app, you can tell it from outside. I can definitely feel why it is one of the 3 essential home appliances. It is really convenient. It washes much more cleanly than I do and uses less water. Since both of us work, I am so busy and tired that I just want to lie down, but thanks to this, I have time to rest. It is hygienic because I don't have to pile up the dishes in the dishwashing bin! My husband uses it more than I do and is satisfied.

Comments (English): [ Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher 6-Place Set ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a product I bought with my own money! Reason for Purchase: The existing 3-4 place dishwasher was too small. Although we are a two-person household, it was insufficient for us as we use a lot of dishes and pots and cook at home, so I decided to purchase the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop 6-Place Dishwasher! Features of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop 6-Place Dishwasher: High-temperature direct water flow with upper and lower 3D wings. (Upper section: 15cm upper wing / Lower section: 42.5cm wash wing). Various customizable courses and options (Standard, Powerful, Eco, Quick, Drum Sterilization). Automatic door opening drying. Large capacity folding basket. User Review: The technician contacted me the day before and was incredibly kind during installation; they installed it neatly :). Although it is described as white, it has a slight grayish tint. The size was also bigger than I expected! I tend to take out a lot of dishes and pots, and since we are a family of just two, everything fits comfortably. There are also two cutlery holders, so there is plenty of room. However, if there is a downside, it is that the cutlery holders don't stay in place and keep falling over easily. I cut the detergent into quarters, and that works perfectly. It is incredibly convenient because you just pop it into the dispenser and press the button! Standard mode takes a little over an hour, and the noise is louder than I expected; it is a bit distracting when watching TV. Even so, I love that it cleans everything squeaky clean automatically as long as you do a pre-wash. The door opens automatically once the dishwasher finishes washing. Once I left the door wide open, and another time I left it open just enough for it to open automatically, and when I opened it the next day... Leaving the door wide open definitely speeds up drying, but even when I just left it on automatic door opening, the neatly stacked dishes were mostly dry, with only a few dishes on the bottom remaining wet. Since the door opens automatically, I think I can run it before going out and not worry too much about it after I'm out. I really regret not buying this dishwasher sooner. I highly recommend it!

Although we are a two-person household, it was insufficient for us as we use a lot of dishes and pots and cook at home, so I decided to purchase the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop 6-Place Dishwasher! Features of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop 6-Place Dishwasher: High-temperature direct water flow with upper and lower 3D wings. (Upper section: 15cm upper wing / Lower section: 42.5cm wash wing). Various customizable courses and options (Standard, Powerful, Eco, Quick, Drum Sterilization). Automatic door opening drying. Although it is described as white, it has a slight grayish tint. The size was also bigger than I expected! I tend to take out a lot of dishes and pots, and since we are a family of just two, everything fits comfortably. There are also two cutlery holders, so there is plenty of room. However, if there is a downside, it is that the cutlery holders don't stay in place and keep falling over easily. I cut the detergent into quarters, and that works perfectly. It is incredibly convenient because you just pop it into the dispenser and press the button! Standard mode takes a little over an hour, and the noise is louder than I expected; it is a bit distracting when watching TV. Even so, I love that it cleans everything squeaky clean automatically as long as you do a pre-wash. The door opens automatically once the dishwasher finishes washing. Once I left the door wide open, and another time I left it open just enough for it to open automatically, and when I opened it the next day... Leaving the door wide open definitely speeds up drying, but even when I just left it on automatic door opening, the neatly stacked dishes were mostly dry, with only a few dishes on the bottom remaining wet. Since the door opens automatically, I think I can run it before going out and not worry too much about it after I'm out. I really regret not buying this dishwasher sooner. I highly recommend it!

Sentence (English): I gave it 15+ washes/ days.
Comments (English): [ Surprising Bosch - happy and disappointed ] || ---------------- || I gave it 15+ washes/ days. I wanted to love this Bosch, our first. Maybe I've just been spoiled with past machines, but I am taking off 2 stars because I just cannot fit the frying pan and cookie sheet on the bottom rack like I could my last 5 dishwashers. Design of the bottom rack pegs is just terrible. maybe for overseas families it's fine, not for us. It fits less dishes than our last machines so I have to run it more. Ugh! Description says Tall, but is more like a Standard height because the bottom rack is raised on a lip so spinning arm hits the cookie sheet. Very disappointed in that because now I have to do more hand washing, but because we've been through dishwashers every 5 or 7 years, he wanted to invest in a Bosch since it is known to be reliable. We shall see.As far as cleaning it did a 5-star job, and the drying (despite not having a drying element like my last dishwashers) did a decent job of 4-stars, but only with drying agent. Of course the plastics were still a little wet. I am actually a little impressed, but I should not be required to use drying agent to dry my dishes nor push an Extra Dry button. just make it to do its job to wash and DRY dishes. It is so quiet! Definitely recommend if you need a quiet machine. So, let's just say it's a 3.5 Star unit overall.Bosch team. if you happen to create a new bottom tray with different pegs and want someone to test it out, please send it to me because anything could be better than this. And take a look at what Whirlpool has done because those are much better, larger bottom trays.Another note: The two silverware containers are very cheap and it's a good thing we kept the old container from our last dishwasher cuz I like that one better and it is definitely sturdier. Not Bosch specific. I wish they'd go back to putting utensil racks on the inside of the door. For over 23 years we have always had a machine with utensil rack on the door, they just don't seem to make those anymore and it's such a shame.

Sentence (English): A very nice and extremely quiet dishwasher with a couple of things to be aware of.
Comments (English): [ Very good, but not perfect ] || ---------------- || A very nice and extremely quiet dishwasher with a couple of things to be aware of. We've had the unit for about six-weeks with no problems to report. Installation was uncomplicated and Costco's third party installer was great. So far, we've got clean dishes, which is the whole point. Be aware that, as others have described, the lower rack does not use a designated track to guide it in and out. Instead, the rack has wheels that roll on an extruded ledge along each side of the lower cabinet interior. This requires that you move the lower rack in and out carefully and in a straight line to keep it aligned and prevent it from getting jammed. This is further complicated by the door not liking to lay completely flat (horizontal). Not the best design, here. The controls are unremarkable and anyone can figure out how to get the thing to do it's job without difficulty. It's a "smart" dishwasher, but only if you're smarter! The instructions that came with the unit don't seem to offer any direction for connecting to Samsung's appliance app, although the thing has asked to connect to one of our smartphones. We haven't tried that yet. There does not seem to be any requirement to register the dishwasher for warranty purposes. I'm not sure if Costco takes care of that or if one just keeps the receipt, but there's not much offered in the accompanying manual about warranty services. Like the "smart" features, one needs to do some homework to become fully knowledgeable. Overall, the fit and finish seem good, the unit is extremely quiet, and the resulting clean dishes are a testament to the dishwasher's capability. The negatives are manageable, so far.

Sentence (English): If this was our first dishwasher maybe I would rate it a 5 star product, but it isn't and therefore I have the previous dishwasher (Asko) as comparison.
Comments (English): [ Close, but needs improvement ] || ---------------- || If this was our first dishwasher maybe I would rate it a 5 star product, but it isn't and therefore I have the previous dishwasher (Asko) as comparison. I'll start with the top rack which is designed for silverware. Took a little while to understand the best configuration to place the forks, spoons and knives. Finally, I did. The middle rack still has me flummoxed as to how to stack glasses for stability and best fit. After approx. 2 months I still can't seem to get the hang of how glasses should be placed on the rack for stability of fragile items, secured placement and maximum number of glasses, cups and other items suitable for that rack. The bottom rack is ok. Interesting is the top rack is plastic which retains water and therefore when the rack is slid out to remove the silverware the water transfers to the silverware. Because the best way to unload the dishwasher is from the lowest rack up there is no issue with any water falling onto any dishes on the lower racks. On our previous dishwasher, the front panel would remain lit alerting the homeowner the cycle is complete and ready to be unloaded. The Bosch's front panel light turns off after a short period of time (most likely to make it more efficient, but really, how much power can a panel use? ) leaving some family members not knowing the washer has been run and can be unloaded.

Sentence (English): I purchased two of these dishwashers, one for home and another for a rental property.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher, EXCEPT.  ] || ---------------- || I purchased two of these dishwashers, one for home and another for a rental property. They do an excellent cleaning job when they work but both of them became undependable within two years due an identical issue. the user interface board in the door stopped working. I could get them to run by turning the circuit breaker off and on until finally that no longer worked either.I purchased a new interface board for one of them. The door must be removed and dismantled to remove and replace this board.I found two things that I believe contributed to the boards demise. The first was the screw-on vent on the door interior was not as tight as it could have been which may have allowed steam to affect the boards integrity. The board appears to have a protective coating but who knows? The second was the plastic support pins to which the board is fastened with screws. Two of these pins were broken, possibly from being overtightened at the factory. The broken supports allowed the board to flex anytime a button was pushed, possibly causing a break in connections. I removed the broken supports that came out with the old board and super-glued them where they had broken off. This took more time than swapping the board! With the board replaced, the dishwasher works like new but replacement was tedious and unnecessary, in my opinion, if more care had been taken during factory assembly. Now I need to repair the other dishwasher. On another subject, I do not like the black trays and find them hard to see when loading unless I turn on some very bright lighting.I will probably not purchase another GE dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I used a 12-seater for a long time, but switched to this one, and it has many advantages.
Comments (English): I used a 12-seater for a long time, but switched to this one, and it has many advantages. The 12-seater was unsanitary because dishes and food scraps would sit in the sink all day until the dishes were all collected, which was unsanitary, and bending over to load and remove the dishes was quite a hassle. Larger dishes would have to be washed by hand anyway. Over time, the drain would clog, requiring pipe replacement. This product solves these problems. It's better to manually drain the drain back into the sink for future convenience, and the automatic water supply is more convenient. There's no drying function, but even though my previous model had one, I didn't use it. I'm worried about the electricity bill, so I just leave the door slightly open after washing. It's best to rinse any remaining ingredients thoroughly before loading the dishes. Don't use coated frying pans, as they will peel off the coating. My water bill is usually high, and reducing my hot water usage will be a huge help. I'm very satisfied with the price, Coupang installation, and after-sales service! Anyway, it seems like domestic brands also produce OEM products from this company and just raise the price to sell them. I highly recommend it!

Sentence (English): I purchased two of these dishwashers, one for home and another for a rental property.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher, EXCEPT.  ] || ---------------- || I purchased two of these dishwashers, one for home and another for a rental property. They do an excellent cleaning job when they work but both of them became undependable within two years due an identical issue. the user interface board in the door stopped working. I could get them to run by turning the circuit breaker off and on until finally that no longer worked either. I purchased a new interface board for one of them. The door must be removed and dismantled to remove and replace this board. I found two things that I believe contributed to the boards demise. The first was the screw-on vent on the door interior was not as tight as it could have been which may have allowed steam to affect the boards integrity. The board appears to have a protective coating but who knows? The second was the plastic support pins to which the board is fastened with screws. Two of these pins were broken, possibly from being overtightened at the factory. The broken supports allowed the board to flex anytime a button was pushed, possibly causing a break in connections. I removed the broken supports that came out with the old board and super-glued them where they had broken off. This took more time than swapping the board! With the board replaced, the dishwasher works like new but replacement was tedious and unnecessary, in my opinion, if more care had been taken during factory assembly. Now I need to repair the other dishwasher. On another subject, I do not like the black trays and find them hard to see when loading unless I turn on some very bright lighting. I will probably not purchase another GE dishwasher.

They do an excellent cleaning job when they work but both of them became undependable within two years due an identical issue. the user interface board in the door stopped working. I could get them to run by turning the circuit breaker off and on until finally that no longer worked either. I purchased a new interface board for one of them. The door must be removed and dismantled to remove and replace this board. I found two things that I believe contributed to the boards demise. The first was the screw-on vent on the door interior was not as tight as it could have been which may have allowed steam to affect the boards integrity. The board appears to have a protective coating but who knows? The second was the plastic support pins to which the board is fastened with screws. Two of these pins were broken, possibly from being overtightened at the factory. The broken supports allowed the board to flex anytime a button was pushed, possibly causing a break in connections. I removed the broken supports that came out with the old board and super-glued them where they had broken off. This took more time than swapping the board! With the board replaced, the dishwasher works like new but replacement was tedious and unnecessary, in my opinion, if more care had been taken during factory assembly. Now I need to repair the other dishwasher. On another subject, I do not like the black trays and find them hard to see when loading unless I turn on some very bright lighting. I will probably not purchase another GE dishwasher.

Sentence (English): Cleans exceptionally well and dries better than any other dishwasher I've ever owned.
Comments (English): [ So far so good… ] || ---------------- || Cleans exceptionally well and dries better than any other dishwasher I've ever owned. Why 3 stars? Cost: it wasn't cheap and given what it costs I don't think we should be experiencing any downsides; those downsides being odor and connectivity. Regarding the odor, there was a very strong, pungent chemical smell when first using. Forums seemed to indicate this was common and would diminish with time. It has diminished but after a month it hasn't disappeared yet. The app is needed in order to use some of the features paid for in the 800 series, so you'd think they'd have that locked down, but no. Connectivity is far from solid, and at this price point, seems offensively negligent on Bosch's part. We've had to remove and add again the appliance from the app a few times already in order to get it to connect the network. No other device on our WiFi network from washer and dryer to tv has had this issue, so it's the dishwasher as far as I'm concerned. Pros? It cleans the extremely well and is quiet. I've thrown ramenins from French onion soups with baked on cheese and they came out sparkling clean! There will be an odd chemical odor though. Can't speak to longevity given we've had it for about a month plus a week or two. It's good, but at this price, it should be better in my opinion. Buyer beware.

Sentence (English): I received my new Samsung Dishwasher last January 2024.
Comments (English): [ Cleans great but not built to last ] || ---------------- || I received my new Samsung Dishwasher last January 2024. It has been 25 years since I purchased a dishwasher. It seemed as if my old Maytag would last forever. Though I do like the new features and flexibility with the new Samsung, I can see that it was cheaply manufactured and I don't hold high hopes that it will last as long as my old dishwasher. So far the dishwasher works well and cleans the dishes thoroughly. There weren't any instructions or details sent with the unit. I had to resort to searches online or YouTube to figure out how to operate it. There is a learning curve as this new dishwasher has many different cycles and features my old unit did not have. The information I found online says you do not need to rinse the dishes, just scrape off food and place it in the dishwasher. Since my home is just me and my husband, we only need to run the dishwasher 1-2 times a week. We rinse our dishes as we don't want food to harden on the dishes over the days in between running the dishwasher.One problem I have noticed is after every cycle there is about 2 inches of water left behind at the bottom. It took me several web searches and Youtube videos to find out that you have to run a draining cycle after completing a wash cycle which only takes a couple of minutes but it is a real pain. I run the dishwasher, empty it then run a separate drain cycle. Why can't that be completed automatically? My favorite feature is that the 42 dBS is so quiet! Running water from the tap is louder than running the dishwasher for 2 hours. Purchasing the quieter dishwasher is definitely worth it.Overall the Samsung Dishwasher is ok. My only complaints are that it is too expensive, cheaply made and not supplied with enough information on how to use it.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher itself is great.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher. ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher itself is great. Quiet, effective, lots of thoughtful touches. I hope it it gives me the same 22+ years my last Bosch gave me. My experience with Best Buy - not so great. I bought an open box model at a steep discount (some light cosmetic scratches I'll never see). No free install, okay; it was going to be $185 to have them install it. Not the end of the world. But then they were going to charge a delivery fee of $100, even though they also refused to deliver it - I had to bring a friend's SUV to pick it up. The $100 was because the installer was making a \"special trip.\" So now it's about $300 to install a $565 dishwasher. Hmm. (I ended up doing it myself - since I was replacing an existing dishwasher it was super easy, basically a 10 minute job including leveling it.). Then they insisted I needed a junction box - \"every Bosch needs a junction box,\" the appliances product specialist (or whatever title they have these days) said. Turns out - no. Mine had a 110V plug and, under the sink meant just for the dishwasher, guess what, a 110V outlet. Returning it was easy, but did require another trip to the store, which was a lot less organized and more chaotic than I remember. (I worked at stores 32, 33, and 150 for about 7 years, in high school and college.)

Sentence (English): When you spend this kind of money on an appliance, you would hope the little things are right.
Comments (English): [ It's the small things.  ] || ---------------- || When you spend this kind of money on an appliance, you would hope the little things are right. In general, this dishwasher does what it needs to do - it cleans the dishes well. But oh my gosh, the littlest thing about this dishwasher makes me crazy, and that is the cheap little clips that hold the bottom rack tines upright instead of laying flat. Over time, and I mean over a very short time, the clips don't hold the tines upright, so when we put plates in, the tines fold flat by themselves and the plates go everywhere. I have tried wiring the clips to prevent this, I have tried super glue, and next I am going to have to find a more permanent solution (like a new dishwasher). It is totally maddening that these things are so freaking cheap in an appliance like this. Good grief.

Comments (English): [ Buy elsewhere - Samsung doesn't care at all! ] || ---------------- || I ordered this dishwasher on Nov. 29, 2023 (Black Friday / Cyber Monday deal) to be delivered on Feb. 1, 2024. To rectify, I have to reorder the dishwasher at a higher price (and hope they'll price match it). So I order it again. (Samsung tells me they can only price match after delivery). So I wait. February 9th, 2024 - the dishwasher arrives but cannot be installed as installer tells me I have to replace my "rusted" water valve. Samsung does honor the price match finally; I hire a plumber to replace it and call Samsung to setup new install date for March 1st. Due to rains & late day, the installer doesn't come. Reschedule for March 5. Samsung installer comes installs but says the base panel is missing; delivery team didn't deliver it. March 7 - I speak to Samsung.com chat agent to report missing panel. Sentence (English): NOT in this case.
Comments (English): [ Normally, you get what you pay for.  ] || ---------------- || NOT in this case. We purchased a "top of the line" 800 premium series bosch dishwasher. It is nice and quiet., I thought the third top rack would come in very useful, but had to remove, as no space for glassware on rack beneath. Speaking of glassware. EVERY wine glass on the second rack comes out with dried debris that must have been blown in during the wash cycle, not removed during the rinse. and then baked on! I'm constantly having to soak the glasses to get the debris soft enough to remove. Most importantly, the machine caused a flood (less than a year after having it). Luckily we were home and caught it before it damaged hardwood floors. Waited three weeks for a bosch repairman. He was unable to find any reason for the leak, recommended I change detergent for the debris issue, and that was it. Now, I don't trust the machine. I can't run it if I'm going to bed, or if I'm not going to be home to monitor it. If it hadn't been caught the first time we would be replacing $$$$ of hardwood flooring.I have owned rental properties, and have replaced dozens of dishwashers. with no specific brand, but all relatively inexpensive. I've NEVER had a leak, or unclean dishes. Extremely disappointed with this machine, and definitely would not recommend. Also, probably won't be replacing the rest of my appliances with bosch products. All you're doing is paying extra for the name. you're not getting any better product or service!
